RFC 8693 OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange

Token Exchange allows a client to request a security token from a Security Token Service.

2. Token Exchange Request

The client MUST authenticate when required by the authorization server.

ParameterMeaning
subject_tokenIdentifies the represented subject.
grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange

Section 2 defines the request and its security requirements.
